title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
summary: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.
author: Oliver Roup
